entries.en: The review compares antipsoriatic treatments without ranking individual products.
entries.zh: 综述比较了治疗牛皮癣的方法，但没有给各个产品排名。

entries.en: The conservator compared two antiputrescent preparations before treating the wooden panel.
entries.zh: 修复师在处理木板前比较了两种防腐制剂。

entries.en: An unopened jar of antipyrotic remained in the abandoned dispensary.
entries.zh: 那间废弃药房里还留着一罐未开封的治灼伤药。

entries.en: The defence exhibition included an antiradar missile beside the radar display.
entries.zh: 国防展在雷达展区旁展出了一枚反雷达导弹。

entries.en: The report compares the costs of several antiradiation shielding materials.
entries.zh: 报告比较了几种抗辐射屏蔽材料的成本。

entries.en: His antiradical essays attracted readers who distrusted sudden political change.
entries.zh: 他那些反激进主义的文章吸引了不信任骤然政治变革的读者。

entries.en: She chose lenses with an antireflection coating for her new glasses.
entries.zh: 她为新眼镜选择了带防反射涂层的镜片。

entries.en: The photographer requested antireflective glass for the framed exhibition prints.
entries.zh: 摄影师要求给展出的装框照片配上减反射玻璃。

entries.en: The editor moved the diagram of an antireflux valve to the next page.
entries.zh: 编辑把抗反流阀的示意图移到了下一页。

entries.en: Her research focuses on the cost of antirejection medication after transplantation.
entries.zh: 她的研究重点是移植后防排斥药物的费用。

entries.en: The publisher rejected his antireligious pamphlet but returned the manuscript politely.
entries.zh: 出版商拒绝出版他那本反宗教的小册子，但礼貌地退还了手稿。

entries.en: The archive keeps the antirevolution leaflets apart from the revolutionary newspapers.
entries.zh: 档案馆把反革命传单与革命报纸分开存放。

entries.en: The mechanic replaced the worn bushings on the car's antiroll bar.
entries.zh: 修理工更换了汽车抗侧倾杆上磨损的衬套。

entries.en: A tin of antirust leaked onto the workshop floor overnight.
entries.zh: 一罐防锈剂在夜间漏到了车间地板上。

entries.en: The gate still needs an antirusting treatment before its final coat of paint.
entries.zh: 大门在刷最后一道漆之前还需要做防锈处理。

entries.en: The historian traced an antisabbatarian argument through several nineteenth-century pamphlets.
entries.zh: 历史学家在几本十九世纪的小册子中追溯了一种反对守安息日的论点。

entries.en: An antisaloon campaign divided the town long before the election.
entries.zh: 一场反对卖酒的运动早在选举前就让镇上的人产生了分歧。

entries.en: The maintenance log records when the boiler received its antiscale treatment.
entries.zh: 维护日志记录了锅炉接受防垢处理的时间。

entries.en: Her antiscience rhetoric drew criticism from teachers at the public meeting.
entries.zh: 她那番反对科学的言论在公众会议上受到了教师们的批评。

entries.en: The reviewer challenged the book's antiscientific claims with carefully documented evidence.
entries.zh: 书评作者用记录详实的证据质疑了书中反对科学的说法。

entries.en: The history chapter discusses antiscorbutic foods carried on long sea voyages.
entries.zh: 历史章节讨论了长途海上航行中携带的抗坏血病食物。

entries.en: The preacher condemned the proposal as antiscriptural during the debate.
entries.zh: 那位传教士在辩论中谴责这项提议违反《圣经》。

entries.en: The architect revised the antiseismic design after reviewing the soil report.
entries.zh: 建筑师审阅土壤报告后修改了抗震设计。

entries.en: The novelist gives the headmaster an antisex outlook that frustrates his students.
entries.zh: 小说家赋予校长一种反对性行为的观念，这让他的学生感到沮丧。

entries.en: The students drafted an antisexist policy for their debating society.
entries.zh: 学生们为自己的辩论社起草了一份反对性别歧视的规章。

entries.en: An antisexual message runs through the villain's speeches in the play.
entries.zh: 剧中反派人物的演说贯穿着一种反对性行为的思想。

entries.en: The museum labels the antiship missile as a training model.
entries.zh: 博物馆把这枚反舰船导弹标为训练模型。

entries.en: The syllabus places antishock treatment in the emergency medicine module.
entries.zh: 课程大纲把抗休克治疗安排在急诊医学模块中。

entries.en: The technician checked the telephone's antisidetone circuit before closing the casing.
entries.zh: 技术员在合上外壳前检查了电话的反侧音电路。

entries.en: The driver spread an antiskid mat under the wheel stuck in mud.
entries.zh: 司机在陷入泥里的车轮下面铺了一块防滑垫。

entries.en: The engineer examined the antislip mechanism after the belt began slipping.
entries.zh: 皮带开始打滑后，工程师检查了防滑转机构。

entries.en: The mayor's antismog plan faced questions about its funding.
entries.zh: 市长防治烟雾污染的方案受到了关于资金来源的质疑。

entries.en: The harbour authority postponed its antismuggling briefing until the afternoon.
entries.zh: 港务部门把反走私简报会推迟到了下午。

entries.en: The librarian opposed an antismut proposal that would restrict the entire collection.
entries.zh: 图书管理员反对一项禁淫秽书报的提案，因为它会限制整个馆藏。

entries.en: Our antispam filter mistakenly sent the invitation to the junk folder.
entries.zh: 我们的反垃圾邮件过滤器误把邀请函送进了垃圾邮件文件夹。

entries.en: The repair manual shows an antispark component beside the switch.
entries.zh: 维修手册显示开关旁边有一个消火花元件。

entries.en: The council debated an antispeculation tax on empty investment properties.
entries.zh: 市议会讨论了针对空置投资房产征收反投机税的问题。

entries.en: She fitted an antisplash guard around the sink before painting the wall.
entries.zh: 她在刷墙之前给水槽周围装上了防溅挡板。

entries.en: The flight instructor explained the aircraft's antistall system before the simulator session.
entries.zh: 飞行教练在模拟训练前讲解了飞机的防失速系统。

entries.en: Police seized the antistate pamphlets in the final chapter of the novel.
entries.zh: 小说最后一章中，警方没收了那些反政府的小册子。

entries.en: Keep the replacement memory module inside its antistatic bag until needed.
entries.zh: 在需要使用之前，请把替换用的内存模块留在抗静电袋里。

entries.en: The mould received an antisticking coating before the next production run.
entries.zh: 开始下一轮生产前，模具涂上了抗粘着涂层。

entries.en: The bibliography lists several papers on antistreptococcal immunity.
entries.zh: 参考文献列出了几篇关于抗链球菌免疫的论文。

entries.en: The model builder added an antisub helicopter to the miniature carrier.
entries.zh: 模型制作者给微型航母配上了一架反潜艇直升机。

entries.en: The tutor asked us to prove that the relation is antisymmetric.
entries.zh: 辅导老师让我们证明这个关系是反对称的。

entries.en: An antisymmetrical matrix appeared in the final step of her calculation.
entries.zh: 她计算的最后一步中出现了一个反对称矩阵。

entries.en: She wrapped the silver necklace in an antitarnish cloth before storing it.
entries.zh: 她把银项链包在防失光泽的布中，再收了起来。

entries.meaningZh: 反对以牺牲人道发展技术的
entries.en: Her antitechnology manifesto condemns inventions that sacrifice human dignity for efficiency.
entries.zh: 她那份反对以牺牲人道发展技术的宣言谴责了为效率而牺牲人类尊严的发明。

entries.en: The committee reviewed funding for the city's antiterrorist training programme.
entries.zh: 委员会审查了该市反恐怖主义培训计划的经费。

entries.en: She shortened the section on antithrombotic drugs to meet the journal's limit.
entries.zh: 为符合期刊的篇幅限制，她缩短了抗血栓形成药物那一节的内容。

entries.en: The lecturer drew an antitone mapping between the two ordered sets.
entries.zh: 讲师画出了这两个有序集之间的一个反序映射。

entries.en: An antitotalitarian theme connects the essays in her latest collection.
entries.zh: 她最新文集中各篇文章都贯穿着反极权主义的主题。

entries.en: He disabled the browser's antitracking setting while testing the advertising script.
entries.zh: 测试广告脚本时，他关闭了浏览器的反跟踪设置。

entries.meaningZh: 反对三位一体说的〔宗教〕
entries.en: The scholar examined antitrinitarian arguments without endorsing either side of the dispute.
entries.zh: 这位学者考察了反对三位一体说的论点，但没有支持争论中的任何一方。

entries.en: A specialist reviewed the chapter on antitubercular medicines before publication.
entries.zh: 出版前，一位专家审阅了有关抗结核药物的章节。

entries.en: The shipment of antituberculosis medication arrived with a damaged outer carton.
entries.zh: 那批抗结核药物到货时，外纸箱已经破损。

entries.en: The translator checked every antituberculous drug name against the original document.
entries.zh: 译者对照原始文件核对了每一个抗结核药物的名称。

entries.en: The catalogue gives the antiulcer preparation a different product code.
entries.zh: 目录给这种抗溃疡制剂标了另一个产品代码。

entries.en: Workers criticised the manager's antiunion remarks during the staff meeting.
entries.zh: 工人们在员工会议上批评了经理反对工会的言论。

entries.en: Her antiutopian novel follows a librarian who secretly preserves banned books.
entries.zh: 她的反面乌托邦小说讲述了一位秘密保存禁书的图书管理员的故事。

entries.en: The museum's medical display includes an old box marked antivenomous serum.
entries.zh: 博物馆的医学展区有一个标着抗蛇毒血清的旧盒子。

entries.en: New antivibration pads were fitted beneath the laboratory's sensitive balance.
entries.zh: 实验室那台灵敏天平下面装上了新的防振垫。

entries.en: An antivivisection petition circulated outside the university's animal research building.
entries.zh: 一份反对活体解剖的请愿书在大学动物研究楼外传阅。

entries.en: The antiwar march ended quietly when the rain became heavier.
entries.zh: 反战游行在雨势加大时平静地结束了。

entries.en: The manufacturer changed the antiwear additive but kept the packaging design.
entries.zh: 厂家更换了抗磨损添加剂，但保留了包装设计。

entries.en: The journalist challenged the candidate's antiwhite rhetoric during the interview.
entries.zh: 记者在采访中质疑了那位候选人敌视白人的言论。

entries.en: The laboratory compared antizymotic agents in a study of food preservation.
entries.zh: 实验室在一项食品保藏研究中比较了抗发酵剂。

entries.en: The worksheet pairs each adjective with an antonymic counterpart.
entries.zh: 练习把每个形容词与一个对应的反义词配成一对。

entries.en: The diagram shows an anuclear cell beside one with a clearly visible nucleus.
entries.zh: 示意图把一个无细胞核的细胞画在一个细胞核清晰可见的细胞旁边。

entries.en: She marked the anucleate cells with arrows on the microscope image.
entries.zh: 她用箭头在显微图像上标出了那些缺胞核的细胞。

entries.en: The researcher photographed the anucleated cell before moving the slide.
entries.zh: 研究人员在移动载玻片之前给那个去核细胞拍了照。

entries.en: The long silence after my interview was more anxiety-provoking than the questions.
entries.zh: 面试后的长时间沉默比那些问题更令人焦虑。

entries.en: An anxiety-ridden father paced the corridor while his daughter auditioned.
entries.zh: 女儿试镜时，一位忧心忡忡的父亲在走廊上踱步。

entries.en: Her apagogic argument begins by assuming that the proposed solution is impossible.
entries.zh: 她的反证法论证先假定所提出的解是不可能的。

entries.en: The professor outlined an apagogical proof before presenting the direct approach.
entries.zh: 教授在介绍直接证法之前先概述了一个反证法证明。

entries.en: The physician recorded an aparalytic illness in the case notes.
entries.zh: 医生在病例记录中记下了一种不伴麻痹的疾病。

entries.en: The exhibit contrasts apatetic coloration with the warning patterns on other insects.
entries.zh: 展览把拟色现象与其他昆虫身上的警戒色纹作了对比。

entries.en: His apathetical response made it clear that the argument would not continue.
entries.zh: 他那无动于衷的回应表明，争论不会再继续下去。

entries.en: The sculptor gave the imaginary creature long arms and an ape-like face.
entries.zh: 雕塑家给那个虚构生物塑造了长胳膊和一张像猿猴的脸。

entries.en: An aperitive drink arrived before the first course of our meal.
entries.zh: 我们这顿饭的第一道菜上桌前，先送来了一杯开胃饮料。

entries.en: My brother went apeshit when he found his bike in the river.
entries.zh: 我兄弟发现自己的自行车在河里时，气得暴跳如雷。

entries.en: The aphasiac communicated her choice by pointing to a photograph.
entries.zh: 那位失语症患者指着一张照片表达了自己的选择。

entries.en: The diagram uses arrows to show the direction of apheliotropic growth.
entries.zh: 示意图用箭头表示背光性生长的方向。

entries.en: The survey lists aphidicolous insects separately from the plant-feeding species.
entries.zh: 调查把喜蚜昆虫与取食植物的物种分开列出。

entries.en: Several aphidivorous insects were feeding on the underside of the leaf.
entries.zh: 几只食蚜昆虫正在叶片背面取食。

entries.en: The demonstration compared aphlogistic combustion with the visible flame in another burner.
entries.zh: 演示把无焰燃烧与另一个燃烧器中可见的火焰作了对比。

entries.en: Her aphoristical prose rewards a slower reading than the short chapters suggest.
entries.zh: 她的文字多用警句，篇章虽短，却值得细细品读。

entries.en: The report describes aphthoid lesions but includes no photographs.
entries.zh: 报告描述了似小溃疡的病灶，但没有附照片。

entries.en: A hand lens lay beside the aphyric rock sample on the bench.
entries.zh: 工作台上，那块无斑隐晶的岩石样品旁边放着一把放大镜。

entries.en: She drew an apiculated leaf beside a ruler to show its size.
entries.zh: 她在一把尺子旁画了一片顶端细尖的叶子，以显示叶片的大小。

entries.en: The dialect preserves an apocopated form that the standard language no longer uses.
entries.zh: 这种方言保留了一个标准语已不再使用的词尾脱落形式。

entries.en: The old prescription names an apocrustic but gives no preparation instructions.
entries.zh: 那张旧处方写到一种收敛剂，但没有给出配制说明。

entries.en: The museum model depicts an apod moving through a narrow burrow.
entries.zh: 博物馆模型描绘了一只无足动物在狭窄洞穴中移动的情景。

entries.en: The diagram marks an apodemal structure inside the insect's body.
entries.zh: 示意图标出了昆虫体内的一个表皮内突结构。

entries.en: The time-lapse sequence records a shoot's apogeotropic growth after the pot was tilted.
entries.zh: 这组延时影像记录了花盆倾斜后嫩枝的背地性生长。

entries.en: The diagram places the apolar groups toward the centre of the structure.
entries.zh: 示意图把非极性基团画在结构的中央位置。

entries.en: An apolaustic spirit fills the novel's scenes of feasting and idle conversation.
entries.zh: 小说中宴饮和闲谈的场景充满了享乐的气息。

entries.en: He left an apologetical message after missing our meeting for the second time.
entries.zh: 他第二次错过我们的会面后，留了一条道歉的消息。

entries.en: She examined the apophyllous flower before sketching each separate perianth segment.
entries.zh: 她先检查了那朵花被片分离的花，再画出每一片独立的花被片。

entries.en: The palynologist photographed the aporate pollen grains at a higher magnification.
entries.zh: 孢粉学家用更高的放大倍数拍摄了那些无孔花粉粒。

entries.en: The guide explained the insect's aposematic colours without touching it.
entries.zh: 向导没有碰那只昆虫，就讲解了它的警戒色。

entries.en: The student drew an aposepalous flower next to one with a fused calyx.
entries.zh: 学生在一朵萼片合生的花旁画了一朵萼片分离的花。

entries.en: The botanist compared aposporous reproduction with the cycle shown in the textbook.
entries.zh: 植物学家把无孢子生殖与教科书所示的生活史作了比较。

entries.en: The bishop condemned the author's apostatic writings during the public dispute.
entries.zh: 主教在公开争论中谴责了这位作者弃教的著作。

entries.en: An apostatical member betrays the movement in the second act of the play.
entries.zh: 剧中第二幕，一名变节的成员背叛了这场运动。

entries.en: The pianist gave the appassionato passage a stronger sense of urgency.
entries.zh: 钢琴家让那段热情的乐段有了更强的紧迫感。

entries.en: The renovation included the main house and its appendent buildings.
entries.zh: 翻修工程包括主楼及其附属建筑。

entries.en: She greeted his proposal with an applausive smile and a firm nod.
entries.zh: 她带着赞赏的微笑并坚定地点头，回应了他的提议。

entries.en: An apple-cheeked child waved to us from the upstairs window.
entries.zh: 一个脸颊红润的孩子从楼上的窗口向我们挥手。

entries.en: She painted the kitchen chairs apple-green and left the table white.
entries.zh: 她把厨房椅子刷成苹果绿，让餐桌保持白色。

entries.en: He kept the workshop in apple-pie order, with every tool in its place.
entries.zh: 他把车间收拾得井井有条，每件工具都各在其位。

entries.en: The course takes an application-oriented approach to teaching numerical methods.
entries.zh: 这门课采用面向应用的方法教授数值方法。

entries.en: An application-specific chip handles the camera's image-processing tasks.
entries.zh: 一枚专用芯片负责这台相机的图像处理任务。

entries.en: The insurance claim covered only appraisable objects listed in the inventory.
entries.zh: 保险索赔只涵盖清单中列出的可估价物品。

entries.en: His appraisive comments focused on the painting's structure rather than its price.
entries.zh: 他评价性的评论着眼于画作的结构，而不是价格。

entries.en: She sent an appreciatory letter to the volunteers who repaired her fence.
entries.zh: 她给那些帮她修好围栏的志愿者寄去了一封感谢信。

entries.en: The reviewer marked three proposals as approvable and returned the rest for revision.
entries.zh: 审核人把三份提案标为可核准，其余的退回修改。

entries.en: The proof shows that this function is approximable by simpler polynomials.
entries.zh: 证明表明，这个函数可以用较简单的多项式逼近。

entries.en: The engineer compared the appulsive forces acting on the two barriers.
entries.zh: 工程师比较了作用在两道屏障上的撞击力。

entries.meaningZh: 滑雪后的社交活动〔法语〕
entries.en: We skipped the apres-ski and went back to the chalet for an early night.
entries.zh: 我们没参加滑雪后的社交活动，而是回小木屋早些休息。

entries.en: An aproctous animal appears in the zoologist's detailed anatomical drawing.
entries.zh: 动物学家细致的解剖图中画着一只无肛门动物。

entries.en: The method specifies an aprotic solvent but leaves the temperature unchanged.
entries.zh: 该方法规定使用质子惰性溶剂，但温度保持不变。

entries.en: The guard found a stranger aprowl behind the locked warehouse.
entries.zh: 守卫发现一个陌生人在上锁的仓库后面偷偷徘徊。

entries.en: The grammar lists these aptotic nouns separately from nouns that change their endings.
entries.zh: 这本语法书把这些没有词形变化的名词与词尾有变化的名词分开列出。

entries.en: The case report records an apyretic interval between two episodes of fever.
entries.zh: 病例报告记录了两次发热之间的一段无热期。

entries.en: The pond's aquatical plants were moved into deeper water during the repairs.
entries.zh: 修缮期间，池塘里的水生植物被移到了更深的水中。

entries.en: A thin, aquiform mixture collected at the bottom of the beaker.
entries.zh: 烧杯底部积起了一层稀薄的水状混合物。
